tasks.behavior: One chain whose RPC hosts are down no longer stops the api, worker and signer: that chain waits until two hosts answer again, and the other chains keep working
acceptance: When an enabled chain's RPCs don't answer at startup (fewer than two hosts answer, or a read fails), the api, worker and signer log that chain as unavailable and start, as they already keep running through an outage; nothing is decided paid or settled without the second RPC (D-15), as before
A mistake in the chain list or on chain still stops them: a chain missing from the list, a role without a host, a host on another chain, no factory code, or an executor without gas
The startup factory check (address.FactoryDeployed) asks the second RPC when the primary errors, instead of stopping on the primary's error
